name: False Positive Management and Tool Rationalization
source: False Positive Management and Tool Rationalization/False Positive Management and Tool Rationalization - Interview Questions & Answers.md

prompts.title: How do you prioritize findings from SAST, SCA, DAST, and CSPM?
prompts.answerMarkdown: **A:** **Dedupe** on CVE/CWE+location, enrich with **exposure** (internet-facing?), **reachability**, **exploit intelligence** (KEV/EPSS), and **asset tier**. One ticket per root cause.

prompts.title: When is a suppression acceptable?
prompts.answerMarkdown: **A:** When triage proves **not exploitable** in context, with **written rationale**, **approver**, **scope**, and **review date**-not to avoid fixing real bugs.

prompts.title: Two SCA tools—keep both?
prompts.answerMarkdown:
**A:** Usually **no**-pick primary by **ecosystem coverage** and **CI integration**; duplicate creates ticket spam.
